intent: Review P3MD task cards PSI-001/002/003 under docs/agent-operations/review-workflow.md and give OpenCode the same model + memory setup as Hermes.
summary: Cross-topic session in the OpenCode harness. (1) Mirrored the 48 Hermes skills into OpenCode (48 directory junctions) and added an omniroute provider (localhost:20128) to opencode.jsonc; installed the Hindsight memory plugin with its extraction LLM pointed at Omniroute. (2) Deleted the two thinkboard Supabase Docker stacks (18 containers + 2 networks; volumes left). (3) Re-checked PSI-001's acceptance after the operator rebased: all four criteria pass (turbopack.root present, Clerk stripped, dev boots 200). (4) Silenced the Google Sans Flex next/font warning by adding fallback + adjustFontFallback:false in frontend-architecture/src/components/themes/font.config.ts; adjustFontFallback:false alone was NOT enough because Next's SWC transform looks up capsize metrics before consulting that flag. (5) Added a root frontend-dev script (cd frontend-architecture && bun run) and confirmed bun is installed. (6) Reviews: wrote obsidian-out/review/PSI-003.md (no task/PSI-003 branch existed at the time) and verified + annotated obsidian-out/review/PSI-002.md; ran obsidian:sync twice with 0 problems. A git rebase --autostash master on task/PSI-003 normalized line endings across the working tree (no content loss; spot-checked AGENTS.md and the Hermes entry) and left a redundant stash, which was dropped. The PSI-003 review card is now stale because task/PSI-003 was created afterwards.

decisions.decision: Review PSI-002/003 on the current tree without switching branches

decisions.decision: Use fallback (not just adjustFontFallback:false) to silence the Google Sans Flex warning
decisions.reason: Next's SWC/Rust font transform looks the font up in capsize-font-metrics.json before consulting adjustFontFallback; providing a fallback array takes the Manual path and skips the lookup

decisions.decision: Use git rebase --autostash master for the review branch
decisions.reason: The branch was already at master's tip so the rebase was a no-op, but the dirty tree blocked a plain rebase
alternatives: Skip the rebase entirely (branch already at master)
